item.title: Instagram Plant Shop Announcement

turns.text: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text.

item.tests: Checks that Instagram feed context leads to a square or 4:5 image without requiring the user to specify dimensions.

answer_sheet.Platform and dimensions: Instagram feed; either square or 4:5 portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Bring home some green” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Visual content and style: Lots of lush potted houseplants on a clean cream background.

must_haves: One finished image has either a 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, not landscape or 9:16.
The headline reads exactly “Bring home some green”.
Multiple lush potted houseplants are clearly visible against a cream background.
The headline is readable at feed-viewing size, with no clipped letters.

turns.text: make a post for a little houseplant shop

dialog.agent:
I'd love to make this for you. Two quick questions first:

1. Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
2. Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.why: The assistant asks the user where the piece will be posted and what text it should include, then waits for answers before making anything.
dialog.user: instagram, like a regular post. and just the words "Bring home some green", nothing else

turns.agent:
I couldn't make your post. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created.

I'd already picked the cheapest image option your free plan allows, a 640px image that costs about 5 credits. There's no cheaper setting to try.

Once you've added credits, I can make it with these settings:
- **Format:** square (1:1), sized for a regular Instagram post
- **Picture:** a cozy, sunlit corner of a houseplant shop with potted plants on wooden shelves
- **Text:** only "Bring home some green"

Just tell me when you've topped up your credits or upgraded your plan. If you want a different look, like a different color scheme or a single plant in close-up, tell me that too.
